fields.topic: Beam idealization and initial bending coupling
fields.finding: The linear eigenproblem uses segment compression geometric stiffness plus the conservative pressure Hessian; it omits initial-moment coupling. The separate corotational nonlinear selected-frame calculation includes the elastic tangent. Euler-Bernoulli circular beams do not resolve local shell ovalization, shear deformation, joints, contact or composite/ceramic defects.
fields.needed: Cross-check with independently formulated beam/shell models and benchmark problems; resolve the relevant local and joint physics rather than treating mesh convergence alone as model validation.
